subject: general
question: Which river is also known as Tsangpo?
solution:
The correct answer is **Brahmaputra river** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **Brahmaputra river**.
 
• **Tsangpo** is the name given to the Brahmaputra river in Tibet, where it originates.
 
• It flows across southern Tibet to break through the Himalayas in great gorges and into Arunachal Pradesh (India) where it is known as **Dihang**.
 
• Upon entering Assam, the river is called **Brahmaputra** and is one of the major rivers in India.
 
• The Brahmaputra plays a crucial role in the ecosystem and economy of the region, supporting agriculture, transportation, and biodiversity.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Ganga river
 Originates from the Gangotri Glacier in Uttarakhand, India, and is considered one of the holiest rivers in Hinduism.
 
 

 2) Gandak river
 Originates near the Nepal-Tibet border and joins the Ganga in Bihar, India, contributing significantly to the Ganga basin.
 
 

 3) Kaveri river
 Originates in the Western Ghats in Karnataka, India, and flows through Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, known for its cultural significance and as a lifeline for the agrarian economy in the region.
